sentences.text: Lucy says she noticed changes in her skin and hair (left photo) alongside symptoms including fatigue and hair loss when her ferritin levels were low.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Lighting and shadows also play a part "Do you have ferritin face?" a young woman asks on TikTok, pointing to dark circles, washed-out skin and brittle hair, alongside before-and-after style photographs.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: The content creator puts these features down to her iron levels.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: It is one of a growing number of videos and posts on TikTok and Instagram claiming that low ferritin - a protein which stores iron in the body - can leave visible clues on your face.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Users list pale or grey-looking skin, dark under-eye circles, dry or cracked lips, hair shedding and weak nails, while others share portraits claiming stark visual differences.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: The phrase "ferritin face" has spread widely across social media, with videos attracting millions of views.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: But doctors say appearance alone cannot diagnose iron deficiency.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: "Ferritin face is not a medical diagnosis," said GP Dr Aziza Sesay, who is based in the West Midlands.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: "However, it may be a clue to tell us that something is going on." Pale skin, hair shedding or brittle nails can accompany low iron, but can also be signs of other conditions, she told BBC News.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Your ferritin levels show how good your body's iron stores are, while haemoglobin is the protein in red blood cells which carries oxygen.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: When haemoglobin is low, the blood cannot carry as much oxygen - a condition known as anaemia.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: But iron stores can become depleted before that happens, meaning someone can be iron-deficient and have symptoms without being anaemic.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: This video can not be played Can you tell your ferritin levels from your face?
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: "You've got no stored iron but you're maintaining your haemoglobin.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: That's the big disconnect," said consultant haematologist Dr Drew Provan.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Dr Sue Pavord, also a consultant haematologist, said iron deficiency is common and often under-diagnosed in women.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: UK guidelines from the British Society of Gastroenterology say ferritin below 15 micrograms per litre indicates absent iron stores, while below 30 generally indicates low iron stores.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Social media users have shared posts and videos claiming that low ferritin can cause visible changes to the face Lucy M, 32, who posts about hair loss as @marvluceskin on Instagram and TikTok, said "ferritin face" seemed to describe changes she had noticed in herself.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: In 2021 she developed heart palpitations, fatigue and hair loss.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: After being told her blood tests were normal and being diagnosed with generalised anxiety disorder, a later test showed her ferritin was 12 micrograms per litre.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Lucy said she looked "grey" and her hair had become dull and brittle.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: She shared photographs with the BBC from when her ferritin was low, compared to when it had recovered, and said the difference between how she felt and looked was "night and day".
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Videos about "ferritin face" often encourage viewers to look for a combination of physical signs - from dark circles and pale skin to dry lips, thinning hair and brittle nails - and compare them with their own appearance.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: "You're not ugly, your ferritin is low", one creator says, pointing to the camera.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Provan said it was "impossible" to determine someone's ferritin levels from how their face looks.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: People who are significantly anaemic may look pale, he explained, while fatigue can contribute to dark circles, but these visual signs are "subjective and unreliable".
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: In people with darker skin, changes in skin colour may be less obvious, Sesay added, meaning someone looking specifically for the signs described online could miss iron deficiency.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Doctors say appearance alone cannot tell you whether your ferritin is low, and that iron deficiency should be confirmed with a blood test For doctors, symptoms and how someone feels are more useful than appearance.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Blood tests matter not only to confirm iron deficiency, Provan and Sesay said, but to establish the cause and guide treatment.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Both said treatment should also address the cause.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Heavy periods, low dietary iron, gastrointestinal blood loss and problems absorbing iron through the gut can all play a role.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Iron deficiency is commonly treated with oral iron.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Pavord said iron tablets are best taken on an empty stomach, ideally first thing in the morning, and advised avoiding tea or coffee around the time they are taken because they can inhibit iron absorption.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Iron can also be obtained naturally from foods including meat, beans, lentils, leafy green vegetables and fortified cereals.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Taking iron supplements without a diagnosis can be harmful, while self-treating could delay the investigation of an underlying problem.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Lucy said social media has nevertheless helped women take symptoms more seriously, and has given some the confidence to ask questions when something feels wrong.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: "There are so many women saying, 'Oh my gosh, this is me," she said, adding that she is not a doctor and presents her content as her own experience.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: For her, doing so has been empowering - giving women information with which to advocate for themselves.
sentences.article_title: Is 'ferritin face' a real thing - and can you really spot low iron from looks?

sentences.text: Dormice have become much rarer in the UK as woodlands and hedgerows are lost Dormouse numbers may be recovering in England and Wales after years of decline, offering a rare piece of good news for one of our best-loved mammals.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: The animal has disappeared from much of the countryside with conservationists warning of a long-term collapse in its population.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: However, new data suggests dormouse numbers increased between 2020-2025,  a period that coincided with warmer springs and summers.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Scientists believe these conditions may help dormice survive, by boosting food supplies and reducing the time they spend asleep.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: That gives the animals more opportunity to breed and build up fat reserves ahead of winter.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Even during spring and summer, when it's cold and wet, dormice can go into short periods of deep sleep But conservationists caution that many questions remain unanswered, and say protecting the woodlands and hedgerows where dormice live remains essential to their long-term survival.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: The only native species of dormice in the UK is the hazel dormouse.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Once widespread across the country, they are now largely confined to southern England and parts of Wales.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: They have become much rarer as large areas of woodland are lost and so far native populations have disappeared from around 20 English counties.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: The National Dormouse Monitoring Programme, led by the conservation charity People's Trust for Endangered Species (PTES),  has been monitoring sites in England and Wales since 1998.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: It found that since 2000, dormouse numbers have fallen by almost 60%, equivalent to an average annual decline of 3.5%.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: More recently, however, there are signs that trend may be reversing.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: The data suggests the population increased by almost 10% between 2020 and 2025, although researchers stress there is considerable uncertainty around that estimate.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: The apparent improvement coincides with a period of warmer, drier-than-average springs and summers.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Report co-author Ian White of PTES described the "upturn"  as "welcome good news" which gives grounds for  "cautious optimism".
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: But he added: "We mustn't lose sight of the bigger picture: populations remain almost 60% lower than they were in 2000." The hazel dormouse spends most of its time in trees, coming out at night to eat flowers, insects, berries and nuts The hazel dormouse is famous for spending much of the year asleep.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: It hibernates from around October to May, spending the winter in a nest on the ground.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Even during spring and summer, dormice can go into short periods of deep sleep, known as torpor, when the weather is cold and wet, or food is scarce.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: This helps the small rodent conserve energy.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Researchers believe warmer summers may be reducing the need for torpor, leaving dormice with more energy for feeding and breeding.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: They say more research is needed to understand what longer-term impacts climate change could have on the species.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Dr Charlotte Armitage, an ecologist who worked on the survey, said significant uncertainties remain, including how dormice will respond to warmer, wetter winters.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: However, she said warmer summer conditions are likely to give the animals more energy to reproduce and raise additional litters.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: "This is good news, but we can't be complacent," she told BBC News.
sentences.article_title: A glimmer of good news for Britain's sleepy dormouse

sentences.text: Volunteers across North and South Tyneside have been pitching in to help clean the nurdles off beaches Research into the effects of a microplastic spillage on sea-birds and marine life will be carried out for the next year after funding was secured.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: A team working across Tyneside is doing tests to discover the impact the pellets, known as nurdles, have on animals, birds and fish, as well as the overall spread.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: Tonnes of microplastics were spilled into the River Tyne on 19 July following a collision between ships at the Port of Tyne.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: Dan Turner, from the North East Bird Survey Group, has been rinsing the stomachs of dead sea-birds Necropsies have been carried out on dead sea-birds at the Dove Marine Laboratory in Cullercoats, North Tyneside, for the past six weeks.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: The current stage is focusing on stomach rinsing, which will check if nurdles have been found in the birds' stomachs.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: "We haven't found any evidence of plastics in the stomachs just yet but we have more to check and have evidence that nurdles have been found in regurgitated material," Turner said.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: The research was prompted over concerns birds could "starve" if they confuse the nurdles for food and fill their stomachs.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: "It's concerning plastics can also break down over time which could have a big effect on the wider food chain as well," Turner added.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: The research team is being led by a team of scientists and experts at Newcastle University and the University of Liverpool.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: They are also being assisted by volunteers and other regional organisations such as Environment Agency, Tyne Rivers Trust and Groundwork North East and Cumbria.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: Over the course of the year the research will also look to map the travel of the plastic pellets.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: The nurdles have been found in beaches across Tyneside, Wearside and Teesside, with experts suggesting they may have reached the coast of Denmark.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: Dr Geoffrey Abbott, a reader in geochemistry at Newcastle University, said: "We hope to visit Denmark to determine if the pellets found are the nurdles from the Port of Tyne spill.
sentences.article_title: Nurdle impact to be researched for a year

sentences.text: "There have been cases where they can travel great distances, for instance a spill in South Africa led to nurdles washing up in Perth, Australia, in no time at all." Members of the public are being asked to continue to send pictures of nurdles to help with the research.

sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: While it won the most votes of all parties in the country, the African National Congress won 31% of the overall vote, one third down from the 46% it gained in 2021, and a far cry from the 65% 20 years ago.

sentences.text: The story of its decline is also clear in the provinces and cities.

sentences.text: The party won a majority in just one of the country's nine provinces, Limpopo.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: It also won the most votes in just two of the eight cities, compared with six at the last local elections.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: The Democratic Alliance (DA) came second in the overall vote with 25%, retaining majority control of the city of Cape Town.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: Former president Jacob Zuma's MK party came third overall with 10%, unseating the ANC as winner in the city of Durban, while the Economic Freedom Fighters (EFF), led by Julius Malema, once seen as a serious challenge to the ANC, came fourth with 6%.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: "This has been a very catastrophic outcome for the ANC," said secretary-general Fikile Mbalula on Saturday.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: "We knew this disaster is coming, we're staring at it.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: As we got into elections, the cost of living of our people was too high.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: It is a decline that is concerning, that is how I characterise it." President Cyril Ramaphosa is due to be replaced as ANC leader next year It's a continuing decline for the ANC, which lost its parliamentary majority in the national elections in 2024 for the first time since the end of apartheid in 1994.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: It then had to form a coalition government with a raft of other parties in what is called the Government of National Unity (GNU).
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: While the Democratic Alliance made significant gains in the cities in these local elections, its overall vote share rose only marginally from 22% in 2021, and was below the 27% it gained in 2016.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: Voter turnout was 52%, an increase from 46% in 2021, when elections were held during the Covid pandemic.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: "This election is delivering a devastating message to the ANC," said political analyst Susan Booysen.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: "These are huge problems," says Booysen, "and have really been affecting the lives of ordinary people, in the suburbs, in the townships, and in very dramatic ways." The big picture looks even more bleak for the ANC.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: The party will elect a new leader next year as Ramaphosa comes to end of his term.
sentences.article_title: 'Devastating message' as ANC records worst-ever result in South Africa election

sentences.text: He is due to stay on as president of the country until the next national elections in 2029, but there are few candidates lined up to succeed him in either role.

sentences.text: So the ANC is going to be a party that by 2029 could be the second biggest rather than the biggest party.
